steps.name: shell
steps.arg:
"mkdir -p renders/source
ffmpeg -v error -y -i song.m4a -ac 1 -ar 22050 renders/source/audio.wav
python3 - <<'PY'
import wave,numpy as np,json
with wave.open('renders/source/audio.wav') as f:
 sr=f.getframerate();y=np.frombuffer(f.readframes(f.getnframes()),np.int16).astype(float)/32768
n=1024; hop=220
s=np.array([abs(np.fft.rfft(y[i:i+n]*np.hanning(n))) for i in range(0,len(y)-n,hop)])
f=np.fft.rfftfreq(n,1/sr)
flux=np.maximum(np.diff(np.log1p(s)*4,axis=0),0).sum(axis=1)
t=np.arange(len(flux))*hop/sr
peaks=[i for i in range(1,len(flux)-1) if flux[i]>flux[i-1] and flux[i]>=flux[i+1] and flux[i]>np.percentile(flux,75)]
sel=[]
for i in sorted(peaks,key=lambda i:flux[i],reverse=True):
 if all(abs(t[i]-t[j])>.25 for j in sel):sel.append(i)
energy=np.sqrt(np.array([np.mean(y[int(k*sr/30):int((k+1)*sr/30)]**2) for k in range(1050)]))
np.save('renders/source/energy.npy',energy)
json.dump({'onsets':sorted([round(t[i],3) for i in sel]),'duration':len(y)/sr},open('renders/source/audio_analysis.json','w'))
print('Strong musical accents:', sorted([round(t[i],2) for i in sel]))
print('RMS per second:',[round(float(np.sqrt(np.mean(y[k*sr:(k+1)*sr]**2))),3) for k in range(35)])
PY"
